title: 描述人和东西
goal: 会描述一个人的长相和性格、一件东西的样子，听懂别人让你帮忙认人或找东西时的描述。
tips: 长相：He's tall and slim. / She has long, curly hair. / He wears glasses.
性格：friendly 友好，funny 风趣，shy 害羞，kind 善良，hard-working 勤奋。
问长相用 What does he look like?；问性格用 What's he like?（两个不一样！）

exchanges.hear: What does your brother look like?
exchanges.reply: He's tall, with short black hair, and he wears glasses.
exchanges.replyZh: 他个子高，黑色短发，戴眼镜。

exchanges.reply: The big gray one with a red tag.
exchanges.replyZh: 那个灰色的大箱子，挂着红色的牌子。

exchanges.hearZh: 你能描述一下你的钱包吗？
exchanges.reply: It's small and brown, made of leather.
Not at all. She's very outgoing.

exchanges.hear: How will I recognize you at the station?
exchanges.reply: I'll be wearing a blue jacket and a white hat.
exchanges.replyZh: 我会穿蓝色夹克，戴白色帽子。

exchanges.hear: What kind of person is your best friend?
exchanges.hearZh: 你最好的朋友是什么样的人？
exchanges.reply: He's funny and kind. He always makes me laugh.
exchanges.replyZh: 他很风趣，也很善良，总能逗我笑。

dialogue.title: 请朋友帮忙去车站接人

lines.en: Could you pick up my cousin at the station tomorrow? I have to work.
lines.zh: 明天你能帮我去车站接一下我表弟吗？我要上班。

lines.en: Sure. But I've never met him. What does he look like?
lines.zh: 好啊。可我没见过他，他长什么样？

lines.en: He's tall and slim, with curly hair.
No, but he has a small beard.
OK. What's he like? Is he talkative?
lines.zh: 好。他性格怎么样？爱说话吗？

lines.en: He's a bit shy at first, but he's really friendly.
lines.zh: 刚开始有点害羞，不过人很友好。

lines.en: Great. What will he be carrying?
A big black backpack. I'll send you his photo.
lines.zh: 一个黑色的大双肩包。我把他的照片发给你。

lines.en: Perfect. Don't worry, I'll find him.
lines.zh: 好的，放心，我会找到他的。
